name: Bit by Bit
description: Digital art visualizing the passage of time in binary.

text: Two ways of keeping time, collapsed into one. The seconds of a clock are converted into binary and displayed as a digital notation that rotates like the second hand of a grandfather clock.
The 1 and 0 of binary double as the letters 'i' and 'o' in 'tick' and 'tock,' merging the mechanical rhythm of analog timekeeping with the logic of computation.
The prep version below strips the concept down to its simplest form. Just the seconds, converted to binary, with the 1 and 0 forming the 'i' and 'o' of tick and tock.
